name: Avanti 7.4 cu. ft. Apartment Size Top Freezer Refrigerator in Black and Platinum
description: A narrow profile and sleek design make this 7.4 cu. ft. Refrigerator/Freezer in Black the ideal kitchen appliance for apartments, townhomes, condos or any dwelling with limited space. It's ambidextrous even if you aren't, as its doors are reversible and feature integrated handles for streamlined styling and utmost versatility. Affordable and efficient, the upright unit is Energy Star-rated for its modest power consumption and boasts an adjustable thermostat that even at its lowest setting won't break the bank on your electricity bill. Adjustable-height glass shelves and door bins supply maximum storage flexibility, while a see-through vegetable crisper keeps produce fresh.
